verdict.rationale: HMRC's GOV.UK guides are written in plain second-person language rather than statute text. They walk founders through tasks in sequence: register with Companies House and opt into Corporation Tax, add services to the business tax account, then manage it online. The VAT registration guide states exact thresholds, voluntary registration and exceptions, and is also available in Welsh. The Making Tax Digital sign-up guidance explains when to sign up, the software requirement and the agent option. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that non-lawyers find these guides easy to follow, and evidence of explicitly numbered step-by-step walkthroughs (the sequence is shown only through prose excerpts).
